sources.boundary: The printed theorem assumes p congruent1 mod4 and a unit whose index is prime to p. Its equality relates the class number multiplied by a p-adic regulator expression to Bernoulli expressions. It supplies no p-unit estimate for either side; section8.3 explicitly requires detailed fundamental units for explicit higher-degree congruences. The existence of a Minkowski generator in the quintic case does not itself imply that its p-adic regulator expression is a unit.
